t: AI Predictive Analytics: Demand Forecaster — Simple
name: AI Predictive Analytics: Demand Forecaster — Simple
title: AI Predictive Analytics: Demand Forecaster — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] A forecaster that predicts demand honestly: it fits seasonal models on history, publishes prediction intervals (not point guesses), and scores itself on held-out data. A forecast without an interval is a guess with formatting.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Growth component: r=0.6, N=400 of K=2000 = 192.0 units. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.
chapter_source: Architecting Solutions: Building AI for Universal Predictive Analytics & Forecasting + Building the AI for Predicting Cultural Shifts
real_world_basis: Seasonal forecasting with prediction intervals is standard in retail, energy, and logistics.
signature_version: Signature version: the foresight Balance assessor — the chapter's A7 Balance (signal vs noise) scored per forecast from backtest data, with the 'universal' framing labeled concept.
build_steps: Build: hold out the last season first, fit on the rest, and publish coverage before trusting any forecast.
math_note: Growth component: r=0.6, N=400 of K=2000: 192.0 units [verified]; Interval-validation samples at 2% error: 2500 samples [verified]

t: AI Predictive Analytics: Cultural Shift Detector — Simple
name: AI Predictive Analytics: Cultural Shift Detector — Simple
title: AI Predictive Analytics: Cultural Shift Detector — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] A detector that spots real cultural movement in noise: it tracks language, purchasing, and participation signals, tests for structural breaks, and reports only shifts that survive the significance bar. Trends are claimed with evidence or not at all.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Shift hypothesis: prior 0.1, lik 0.7, marg 0.3 = 0.2333 posterior. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.
chapter_source: Architecting Solutions: Building AI for Universal Predictive Analytics & Forecasting + Building the AI for Predicting Cultural Shifts
real_world_basis: Structural-break detection is standard econometrics; applied to culture it demands extra humility.
signature_version: Signature version: the foresight Totality assessor — signals monitored vs culture at large as a computed coverage ratio, with the framing labeled concept.
build_steps: Build: define the break test first, require independent confirmation, then report — with the base rate.
math_note: Shift hypothesis: prior 0.1, lik 0.7, marg 0.3: 0.2333 posterior [verified]; Signal-set diversity across 128 signals: 7.0 bits [verified]
safety: Epistemic safety: the detector reports candidate shifts with uncertainty; it must never be cited as proof of a movement.
how_it_works: Signal streams feed break-detection tests; candidate shifts are validated against independent sources. The demo recomputes the Bayes update for a shift hypothesis and the diversity bits of the signal set.
requirements: Re-run the demo program to re-verify every number
standards: Full-file record, never a stub

name: AI Predictive Analytics: Forecast Auditor — Simple
title: AI Predictive Analytics: Forecast Auditor — Simple
description:

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Audit sample for 99% confidence at p=0.2 = 21 samples. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.

real_world_basis: Forecast verification is standard in meteorology and finance; the discipline ports anywhere.
signature_version: Signature version: the foresight First/Last assessor — forecast (first) and outcome (last) anchored per prediction, with the framing labeled concept.
build_steps: Build: log every forecast with a timestamp first, score against outcomes, and retire models below baseline skill.
math_note: Audit sample for 99% confidence at p=0.2: 21 samples [verified]; Binary-outcome entropy at p=0.3: 0.8813 bits [verified]

[REAL ENGINEERING] An auditor that keeps every forecaster honest: it logs predictions with timestamps, compares against outcomes, and publishes calibration and skill scores per model per horizon. Models that can't beat the naive baseline get retired.

Compounding view. Headline number: Audit sample for 99% confidence at p=0.2 = 21 samples. This tier combines the mechanism with its limits: what is real engineering today, what the Signature version adds, and where the boundary sits.

signature_version: Signature version: the foresight First/Last assessor — forecast (first) and outcome (last) anchored per prediction, with the framing labeled concept.
build_steps: Build: log every forecast with a timestamp first, score against outcomes, and retire models below baseline skill.
